categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Carries the 'Tests' label and refactors unit test cases in src/test/script_tests.cpp and src/test/transaction_tests.cpp to remove shared mutable state.
categories.rationale: Refactoring test cases to eliminate shared mutable state improves test cleanliness but does not address flaky tests or add regression coverage. As an internal cleanup of existing unit test cases without framework or signal impact, it is marginal priority.
